interpretation.current_teacher: Existing full NumPy baseline rejects unsupported candidate tails; no fallback teacher log probability is produced.
interpretation.missing_score_rule: A missing required supported score is an error, not an unsupported candidate.
interpretation.original_menu_policy: An unsupported candidate in the original side pool triggers whole-menu fallback to the native/baseline path, rather than deleting that candidate and reranking the remainder. Unsupported movable native candidates also cause fallback.
interpretation.training_gap: Whole-menu fallback does not define complete-pool teacher soft targets for unsupported candidates. No zero, negative-infinity, baseline number or invented teacher score is substituted.

official_format_reference.scope: Current upstream documentation provides general vocabulary-format context only; the diagnosed fallback follows the locally pinned project source, not a new upstream-version adoption.

possible_next_step.alternative: Retaining all scenes requires a separately defined abstention/training policy or an independently qualified OOV-capable teacher contract; neither is implemented here.
possible_next_step.route: A separately reviewed finite pilot may select complete TRAIN scenes whose four original condition pools are fully supported, preserving every candidate inside those pools.
possible_next_step.selection_requirement: Predeclare score-independent selection and disclose restricted coverage; do not claim this covers all TRAIN scenes.

scope: Source and frozen token-metadata diagnosis only; no model execution, training, candidate text or label inspection.
